mapper.select: SELECT * FROM material_request WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM material_request WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM material_request WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{status}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material_request (id, user_id, applicant_name, applicant_group, status, workflow_type, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{applicantName}, #{applicantGroup}, #{status}, #{workflowType}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE material_request SET status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE material_request SET updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE material_request SET status = 'FULFILLED', fulfilled_at = #{fulfilledAt}, fulfilled_by = #{fulfilledBy}, updated_at = #{fulfilledAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE material_request SET status = 'RECEIVED', received_at = #{receivedAt}, updated_at = #{receivedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE material_request SET deleted = 1, deleted_time = #{deletedTime}, deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, purge_after_time = #{purgeAfter}, updated_at = #{deletedTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE material_request SET deleted = 0, deleted_time = NULL, deleted_by = NULL, purge_after_time = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM material_request WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 1
DELETE r FROM material_request r LEFT JOIN material_request_line l ON r.id = l.request_id WHERE l.id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM material_request WHERE deleted = 1 ORDER BY deleted_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM material_request WHERE deleted = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE material_request SET status = 'PENDING', first_reviewer_id = NULL, first_review_time = NULL, second_reviewer_id = NULL, second_review_time = NULL, fulfilled_at = NULL, fulfilled_by = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT applicant_group AS groupName, COUNT(*) AS requestCount, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS memberCount, SUM((SELECT SUM(l.qty) FROM material_request_line l WHERE l.request_id = r.id)) AS totalQty FROM material_request r WHERE deleted = 0 AND applicant_group IS NOT NULL AND applicant_group != '' AND created_at BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY applicant_group ORDER BY requestCount DESC
SELECT * FROM material_request WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'FIRST_OK') AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM material_request WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('PENDING', 'FIRST_OK')

SELECT l.item_id, l.snapshot_name, SUM(l.qty) AS total_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT l.request_id) AS request_count FROM material_request_line l JOIN material_request r ON l.request_id = r.id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.created_at BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY l.item_id, l.snapshot_name ORDER BY total_qty DESC

SELECT DATE(r.created_at) AS date, COUNT(*) AS requestCount, COALESCE(SUM((SELECT SUM(l.qty) FROM material_request_line l WHERE l.request_id = r.id)), 0) AS requestQty FROM material_request r WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND DATE(r.created_at) BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND r.applicant_group = #{groupId} GROUP BY DATE(r.created_at) ORDER BY date

SELECT user_id AS userId, applicant_name AS applicantName, applicant_group AS applicantGroup, COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(created_at)) AS activeDays, COALESCE(SUM((SELECT SUM(l.qty) FROM material_request_line l WHERE l.request_id = r.id)), 0) AS totalQty FROM material_request r WHERE deleted = 0 AND DATE(created_at) BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND applicant_group = #{groupId} GROUP BY user_id, applicant_name, applicant_group ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT applicant_group AS groupName, COUNT(*) AS requestCount, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS memberCount, COALESCE(SUM((SELECT SUM(l.qty) FROM material_request_line l WHERE l.request_id = r.id)), 0) AS totalQty FROM material_request r WHERE deleted = 0 AND applicant_group IS NOT NULL AND applicant_group != '' AND DATE(created_at) BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND applicant_group = #{groupId} GROUP BY applicant_group ORDER BY requestCount DESC
